mapper.insert: insert into integration_webhook_endpoints(tenant_id,endpoint_id,endpoint_token_hash,connection_id,principal_id,provider_type,status,signature_algorithm,max_body_bytes,rate_limit_per_minute,replay_window_seconds,version,created_at,updated_at) values(#{value.tenantId},#{value.endpointId},#{value.endpointTokenHash},#{value.connectionId},#{value.principalId},#{value.providerType},#{value.status},#{value.signatureAlgorithm},#{value.maxBodyBytes},#{value.rateLimitPerMinute},#{value.replayWindowSeconds},#{value.version},#{value.createdAt},#{value.updatedAt}) on conflict(tenant_id,endpoint_id) do update set status=excluded.status,signature_algorithm=excluded.signature_algorithm,max_body_bytes=excluded.max_body_bytes,rate_limit_per_minute=excluded.rate_limit_per_minute,replay_window_seconds=excluded.replay_window_seconds,version=excluded.version,updated_at=excluded.updated_at where integration_webhook_endpoints.version=excluded.version-1
mapper.select: select * from integration_webhook_endpoints where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and endpoint_id=#{endpointId}
select * from integration_webhook_endpoints where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and connection_id=#{connectionId} order by endpoint_id limit #{limit}
mapper.delete: delete from integration_webhook_nonce_reservations where ctid in (select ctid from integration_webhook_nonce_reservations where expires_at < #{before} order by expires_at limit #{limit})
